text:
Renee (CS): Quick flag from Tideway onboarding - new embedding+chat pipeline they turned on overnight. Seeing occasional 5-10x tail latency for multi-turn docs. p95 okay, p99 outliers.
Jon (SRE): Hmm. Did they change model or routing?
Renee (CS): They moved embeddings -> compact-int8 and chat generation -> compact-int8 to unify infra.
Harper (ML): Combining int8 for both can save cost but increases cache pressure when long context + embedding lookups coincide. Likely KV eviction and cold-start kernels.
Jon (SRE): Proposed short mitigations: 1) carve a small high-memory pool for long-context flows, 2) use routing rule to send doc-heavy sessions to fp16, 3) enable prefix_kv for chat.
Renee (CS): Customer prefers minimal copy/paste change. Can we give them a tiny override?
Harper (ML): Suggest this minimal routing override:
```
# routing override for Tideway doc-sessions
routing:
  rules:
    - when: request.tags contains "doc-session"
      route_to: redwood/fp16-latency-opt
    - otherwise: use_model: redwood/compact-int8-v5
cache:
  prefix_kv_enabled: true
  max_prefix_entries: 4500
pooling:
  prefer_high_mem_for_tags: ["doc-session"]
```
Jon (SRE): Also recommend a 4% fp16 canary for 15m and collect p95/p99 plus kv_hit_rate and kernel_fallback_rate. If tail drops >40% -> make routing rule permanent for doc-session tag.
Renee (CS): I'll message the customer: "Can you tag doc sessions and apply the override? We'll run a short fp16 canary and report results within 30m."
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @Jon (SRE) for tideway-prod routing override (job 11077).
Harper (ML): One more: log 100 sample generations from both paths for quick qualitative check for any quant artifacts.
Renee (CS): Great. I'll add action items to the onboarding tracker and mark renewal-risk as watched until we confirm. Will update thread after canary. :white_check_mark:
